Cheating × Being Cheated On × Marriage × Divorce

Shinobu receives an unusual request from his best friend, Mizuki:
"Can you let my wife stay at your place while I'm away on a business trip?"

But Mizuki’s wife, Ai, is none other than Shinobu’s longtime, unrequited love—and his stepsister by marriage.
The feelings Shinobu had long suppressed suddenly resurface, and in a moment of weakness, he crosses the line with Ai.
Their physical relationship, once started, doesn't stop—even after Mizuki returns…!?

In addition to the headline series "Netorikon," this volume includes two other steamy one-shots, featuring an older college girl and a newlywed with spiritual powers!
A highly anticipated first-ever compiled volume, packed with not just the one-of-a-kind NTR series, but also exclusive standalone stories!
